For the four remaining floor pairs with \(a+b=3\), the condition becomes \(x+y\le 4\). Each of the squares  
\[
[0,1]\times[3,4],\ [1,2]\times[2,3],\ [2,3]\times[1,2],\ [3,4]\times[0,1]
\]
intersects this in a right triangle with legs \(1\), area \(1/2\).

The other six unit squares contribute area \(6\). Thus the total area is
\[
6+4\cdot \frac12=8.
\]

\[
\boxed{8}
\]
